leadText:
Eric Medalle (June 15, 1973 — March 13, 2016 ) was the Creative Design Director at The Pokémon Company International and an illustrator for the TFG of Pokémon. He joined TPCi in 2003 as a Senior Graphic Designer. He designed or co-designed almost every international TCG logo since Nintendo took control of card production, until his death. Medalle was also responsible for designing the logos for the seasons and s of and .

A dedication to him appears in the credits of the 19th movie, Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel. In Pokémon Sun, Moon, , the two on are named Isa and Nico, a possible reference to the names of his two daughters.
